questions.question: Which statement best describes Cloud governance?

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe the benefits of using cloud services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe the benefits of security and governance in the cloud
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Cloud auditing: identifying resources that do not comply with a defined baseline.
Cloud governance: using standards, policies, templates, and auditing to keep deployments aligned with organizational and regulatory requirements.
Cloud governance: a model that gives customers more control over operating systems, software, patching, and maintenance.
Cloud auditing: the ability of cloud-scale infrastructure and security services to help withstand distributed denial-of-service attacks.
Governance templates: a service availability commitment that can include an uptime guarantee.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Cloud governance — using standards, policies, templates, and auditing to keep deployments aligned with organizational and regulatory requirements; and Cloud auditing — identifying resources that do not comply with a defined baseline.
